metadata.notes: STEP 1: Reads events from the last 8 hours (two 4-hour windows). AFTER IMPORT: connect your Google account, then re-select the spreadsheet and the 'Events' sheet. The sheet needs a 'timestamp' column.
STEP 2: Collapses all matching rows into one bundle so we can count them. The count is used as {{length(2.array)}} downstream.

STEP 3: Looks up what is NORMAL for this weekday + 4-hour block. AFTER IMPORT: re-select the 'Baseline' sheet. It needs columns: weekday | window | expected_count. Window number = hour divided by 4, rounded down (so 9am = 2, 1pm = 3).

filter.name: Judgeable window AND events have stopped

mapper.data: {"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","max_tokens":400,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"You are writing to a non-technical small business owner. Their contact form submissions have stopped arriving. Facts: about {{3.expected_count}} were expected in the last 8 hours, but only {{length(2.array)}} arrived. Write a short alert (maximum 120 words) that: 1) states plainly what has stopped and for how long, 2) lists the 3 most likely causes in plain English, most likely first, 3) gives one specific first thing to check. Be calm and factual, not alarming. Do not invent details you were not given. Plain text only, no markdown, no code fences."}]}

metadata.notes: STEP 4: The filter on this line is the detection logic — it only continues if (a) this window normally has real activity, (b) we are inside business hours, and (c) actual events are under 25% of expected. AFTER IMPORT: replace YOUR_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Also right-click this module > Add error handler > Resume, so an API failure still lets the alert through.

mapper.subject: Alert: your form submissions have stopped

metadata.notes: STEP 5: Sends the alert. AFTER IMPORT: connect Gmail and change the recipient. If the AI text shows blank, re-map it from module 4's output (Data > content[] > text) — Make arrays are 1-indexed.

STEP 6: Records when we alerted, so a cooldown can be added later. AFTER IMPORT: re-select the 'State' sheet (columns: last_alert_at). Optional next step — add a filter before module 4 that skips if last_alert_at is within the past 12 hours, so the same outage does not alert every run.

notes: IMPORT NOTE: This blueprint is hand-authored, not exported from Make. If import fails or modules appear broken, build from make/BUILD_GUIDE.md instead — that guide is the source of truth.

BUILD THE BASELINE FIRST: pivot your historical events by weekday and 4-hour block, divide by the number of weeks of history, and paste the results into the Baseline sheet. Without it the scenario has nothing to compare against.

AFTER IMPORT CHECKLIST: (1) connect Google Sheets and Gmail on every Google module, (2) re-select spreadsheet and sheet in modules 1, 3, 6, (3) replace YOUR_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in module 4, (4) set the recipient in module 5, (5) add the error handler on module 4, (6) set the scenario schedule to every 4 hours.
SCHEDULING: click the clock icon on module 1 and set it to run every 4 hours. This must match the 8-hour lookback window (two runs of history).
